newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: CRICKET-S.LANKA 163-2 AT LUNCH V INDIA.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-S.LANKA 163-2 AT LUNCH V INDIA.

text.p: Sri Lanka had scored 163 for two in their second innings, a lead of 120 runs, at lunch on the fourth day of the second and final cricket test against India in Colombo on Tuesday.

Scores: Sri Lanka 1st innings 332 (A.de Silva 146, D.Mohanty 4-78) and 2nd innings 163-2 (S.Jayasuriya not out 85, R.Mahamana 35, A.Kumble 2-63); India 1st innings 375 (S.Tendulkar 139, S.Ganguly 147, Muralitharan 4-99).
